segment.source: Raised when the effective column assignment of children changes, dispatched after the layout pass.
segment.target: Emitido quando o effective coluna assignment de children changes, dispatched depois o layout pass.

segment.source: Basic usage. Set the number of columns with ColumnCount and the spacing with ColumnGap and RowGap.
segment.target: Básico uso. Definir o number de colunas com ColumnCount e o espaçamento com ColumnGap e RowGap.

segment.source: Demonstrate how masonry layout updates dynamically. Use item.column to keep items in place.
segment.target: Demonstrate how masonry layout updates dynamically. Use item.column to keep items in place.

segment.source: Positions are adjusted dynamically as images load.
segment.target: Positions são adjusted dynamically as imagens load.

segment.source: Masonry arranges cards, images, or arbitrary controls into a shortest-column waterfall layout, with fixed or adaptive column counts and row/column gaps.
segment.target: Masonry arranges cartões, imagens, ou arbitrary controles into a shortest-coluna waterfall layout, com fixed ou adaptive coluna counts e linha/coluna gaps.

segment.source: Lay out children of unequal heights into balanced columns.
segment.target: Lay out children de unequal heights into balanced colunas.

segment.source: Use responsive values to adapt to different screen widths. ColumnInfo controls the column count at each breakpoint, and Gutter controls the spacing.
segment.target: Usar responsivo values para adapt para diferente tela widths. ColumnInfo controles o coluna count at each breakpoint, e Gutter controles o espaçamento.
